title: DPWH asks P7.3B in lump sum appropriations

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) has proposed 13 lump sum appropriations totalling P7.37 billion for fiscal year 2027, DPWH Sec. Vince Dizon presented during the agency’s Senate budget hearing on Friday. Previously, senators have flagged appropriations that are not itemized, cautioning against a repeat of the infrastructure project scandal. But Dizon explained that several of the applications for its listed lump sums are primarily for rehabilitations and repairs across the country, assuring that the agency would submit to the Congress should it place safeguards in the use of the unitemized appropriations.
